# Exploring the values of semantic association

```{r}
library(tidytable)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

setwd("experiment3")
```

## Read data
```{r}
data_path <- file.path("..", "experiment2", "results")

tanner_df <- read.csv(file.path(data_path, "tanner_semantic_association.csv")) |>
    filter(Acceptability == "Gram") |>
    mutate(full_implementation = paste(implementation, model, sep = "_")) |>
    group_by(implementation, model) |>
    mutate(s_sem = scale(semantic_association)) |>
    ungroup()

ucl_df <- read.csv(file.path(data_path, "ucl_semantic_association.csv")) |>
    mutate(full_implementation = paste(implementation, model, sep = "_")) |>
    group_by(implementation, model) |>
    mutate(s_sem = scale(semantic_association)) |>
    ungroup()

derco_df <- read.csv(file.path(data_path, "derco_semantic_association.csv")) |>
    mutate(full_implementation = paste(implementation, model, sep = "_")) |>
    group_by(article_n, full_implementation) |>
    mutate(
        context_length = ifelse(str_detect(implementation, "sentences1"), "Sentence(N=1)", "All")
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    group_by(full_implementation) |>
    mutate(s_sem = scale(semantic_association)) |>
    ungroup()

# content words pos tags
content_pos <- c("NOUN", "VERB", "ADJ", "ADV")
```

## Plot values over word_n
```{r}
tanner_df |>
    filter(pos %in% content_pos) |>
    filter(model != "Gameselo/STS-multilingual-mpnet-base-v2") |>
    ggplot(
        aes(x = word_n, y = s_sem, color = model)
    ) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth() +
    facet_wrap(. ~ implementation) +
    scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
            "firebrick2", "firebrick4", "steelblue2",
            "seagreen2", "seagreen4", "orchid2",
            "orchid4", "steelblue4"
        )
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Word number", y = "Scaled semantic association", title = "Tanner (2019)") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(file.path("figs", "tanner_word_n_sem.png"), height = 7, width = 10)
```

## Plot variance over word_n
```{r}
tanner_df |>
    filter(pos %in% content_pos) |>
    group_by(id, word_n) |>
    summarize(
        variance = var(s_sem, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |>
    ggplot(
        aes(x = word_n, y = variance)
    ) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
ucl_df |>
    filter(pos %in% content_pos) |>

    summarize(

    ) |>
    ggplot(
        aes(x = word_n, y = variance)
    ) +

    geom_smooth() +
    theme_bw() +

```

```{r}
derco_df |>

    group_by(article_n, word_n) |>
    summarize(

```

## Scatterplot: WE vs SE
Tanner
```{r}
tanner_df |>
    filter(pos %in% content_pos) |>
    group_by(id, word_n, pos, implementation) |>
    summarize(
        avg_sem = mean(s_sem, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |>
    pivot_wider(
        names_from = "implementation",
        values_from = "avg_sem"
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = WE, y = SE, color = word_n)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    facet_wrap(~pos) +
    geom_abline(
        intercept = 0,
        slope = 1,
        linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "WE semantic association",
        y = "SE semantic association",
    ) +
    theme_bw()
```

## Difference between implementations over time
Tanner
```{r}
wide_df <- tanner_df |>
    filter(implementation == "SE") |>
    group_by(word_n, full_implementation) |>
    summarise(
        s_sem = mean(s_sem, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
        names_from = full_implementation,
        values_from = s_sem
    )

# all unique pairs of implementations
implementation_pairs <- combn(
    setdiff(names(wide_df), "word_n"),
    2,
    simplify = FALSE
)

# pairwise differences
diff_df <- map_dfr(implementation_pairs, \(pair) {
    wide_df %>%
        transmute(
            word_n,
            comparison = paste(pair[1], "−", pair[2]),
            difference = .data[[pair[1]]] - .data[[pair[2]]]
        )
})

# Plot all pairwise differences
ggplot(
    diff_df,
    aes(
        x = word_n,
        y = difference,
        color = comparison,
        group = comparison
    )
) +
    geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0,
        linetype = "dashed",
        color = "grey50"
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()) +
    labs(
        x = "Word position",
        y = "Difference in s_lp",
        color = "Implementations"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(diff_df, aes(x = word_n, y = difference)) +
    geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0,
        linetype = "dashed",
        color = "grey50"
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    facet_wrap(~comparison) +
    labs(
        x = "Word position",
        y = "Difference in s_lp"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
```
